title: How long does a gift last?
hook: Does an effort increase in hour one tell us what happens all day?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Separate an immediate gift-exchange response from its persistence over a work shift.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Separate an immediate gift-exchange response from its persistence over a work shift.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: A toy effort boost starts at four units and retains one quarter each hour. What boost remains in hour two? Toy inputs A=[4, 0.25]; B=[4, 1].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[4, 1, 0.25], [4, 4, 4]]. Labels: Hour 1, Hour 2, Hour 3.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: The decaying path and the persistent path start with the same immediate boost. Their later values differ because retention differs. An early response alone cannot tell you which long-run path a real gift-exchange effect follows.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses Initial boost=4, Retention/period=1. What is Hour 2? Answer: 4.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses Initial boost=4, Retention/period=1. What is Hour 2?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 4. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: In real jobs, the effort boost from a surprise raise faded within hours (Gneezy & List, 2006).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Separate an immediate gift-exchange response from its persistence over a work shift.
